sequence_break.name: Sequence Break
sequence_break.desc: Break numbered segments in strict numerical order. Wrong segments bounce with a nope tone until the exit opens.

color_lock.name: Color Lock
color_lock.desc: Ball changes color on every bounce. Segments only shatter when hit by matching color.

portal_rings.name: Portal Rings
portal_rings.desc: Teleport between color-matched portals with wear limit counters that crack and shatter when exhausted.

accumulation.name: Accumulation
accumulation.desc: Balls expire and freeze into solid obstacles with countdown timers, stacking until a ball escapes.

classic.name: Classic Ring Escape
classic.desc: A bouncing ball navigates concentric rotating rings with narrow gaps.

sand_fill.name: Sand Fill
sand_fill.desc: Ball releases hundreds of colorful kinetic sand particles that fill the arena.

pendulum_wave.name: Pendulum Wave
pendulum_wave.desc: Harmonic kinetic pendulums oscillate in hypnotic mathematical phase shifts.

merge.name: Merge Balls
merge.desc: Identical bouncing balls collide to merge into larger tiers with explosive particle rewards.

obstacle_course.name: Obstacle Course
obstacle_course.desc: Pillars, spinning bumpers and gravity hazards challenge the ball trajectory.

black_hole.name: Black Hole
black_hole.desc: Intense gravitational singularity bends the ball orbital path.
